summary: Thin session-authed ApiKeyController over ApiKeyService, mirroring ProjectController. Ownership via requireOwned, mask logic extracted, DTOs separate, cross-file signatures verified. No critical/major findings.

findings.reason: Task 8 explicitly instructs 'не усложнять' (do not introduce a shared helper). Duplication is a single 4-line guard intentionally kept local; matches the project's current convention (BotController also resolves locally).

This endpoint is generate-OR-regenerate (idempotent overwrite of a single per-project row), not a pure create-a-new-resource. 200 is semantically correct and the task left the 200-vs-201 choice to the implementer.
